q: I paid but cannot see my purchase
a: Open Billing in your account first: paid orders and invoices appear there within a few minutes. If it is still missing after an hour, raise a ticket under Billing and payments with the reference from your receipt.

q: I need an invoice or receipt
a: Reply on your ticket with your order reference and the name you want on the invoice, and we will send a receipt within one working day.

q: I cannot log in or forgot my password
a: Use Forgot password on the login page and check your spam folder. If the email never arrives, raise a ticket from the email address you signed up with and we will help you regain access.

q: Something is not working as expected
a: Try refreshing the page or a different browser first. If the problem remains, tell us what you clicked, what you expected, what happened instead, and attach a screenshot.

q: How do I upload my documents for a university application?
a: Open Study abroad in your account, then Documents. Uploads are scanned and stored privately. If a file is refused, check it is a PDF, JPG or PNG under 10 MB.

q: Who sees my passport and visa documents?
a: Only you and the counselor assigned to you. Documents are kept in a private vault and every download is logged.

q: I enrolled but the course is not in My courses
a: Enrolment appears within a few minutes of payment. Refresh My courses; if it is still missing after an hour, raise a ticket with your order reference.

q: How do I check the status of my application?
a: Open Applications in your account. Each application shows its current stage and any message from the employer.
